facts.subject: navigator/attenuverter-in
facts.description: The attenuverter input carries an internal 5V when no cable is inserted, so the knob becomes a bipolar offset.

facts.subject: navigator/attenuator-in
facts.description: The attenuator input carries the same internal 5V when no cable is inserted, feeding the fader.

facts.subject: navigator/attenuator-out
facts.description: Left unpatched, the attenuator output is mixed at unity gain into the attenuverter output.

facts.subject: navigator/attenuator-out
facts.value: cable inserted in the attenuator output (4)
facts.description: Patching output (4) takes it out of the internal unity-gain mix, splitting the module into two utilities.

facts.subject: navigator/attenuverter-out
facts.description: With both outputs used separately and nothing patched in, output (2) is a bipolar manual voltage source.

facts.subject: navigator/attenuator-out
facts.description: Used separately, output (4) is a unipolar manual voltage source driven by the fader over the 5V normal.

facts.subject: navigator/attenuverter-out
facts.value: -5V to +10V with nothing patched anywhere, as the two normalled paths sum at unity
facts.description: Inferred by combining the two stated 5V normals with the stated unity-gain mix; the manual gives no combined range.
